page.layout: One printed page, single text block with brace diagrams inline. Running head top left and top right. Page number centred at the top. Signature and catchword at the foot. Left edge shows the neighbouring page, not transcribed. No marginal notes on this page.

main_text.p: Desperationis est cùm rectè animus sui pendet. 2.Cor.1.9.
Timoris est qua animus rectè ex impendenti malo ægrè afficitur.2.Cor.11.3.
Hinc studium, solicitudo &c.1.Cor.7.11. Si malum sit turpitudo, pudor dicitur. Marc.8.38. Quod etiam ex malo præterito est.Rom.6.21.
Vagarum sanctitas est cùm animus rectè afficitur erga bonum & malum certò vel incertò futurum.1.Cor.29.& 3.
Desiderij sanctitas, est cùm animus rectè appetit bonum verum, certum an incertum.Psal.27.4.

p.i: Atq; huiusmodi est sanctitas simplicium affectionum:

main_text.p: Mixtarum sanctitas est, cùm animus rectè afficitur, circa bonum & malum, præsens, præteritum & futurum. Ex sequentibus.
Amoris sanctitas, est qua animus ex boni præsétis absentisuè naturæ integræ iucunditate afficitur.Psal.26.8.

page.notes: Brace diagrams were rendered as outline lines; the outer brace grouping is approximate. The word "Estq;" is read with some doubt. The left edge strip belongs to the neighbouring page and was left out.
